hypothesis: All 241386 functional/scoring checks pass (performance_correctness suite green, 0 failures, correct exit_code=0x820, dmem_reads=64) — only the single capability check fails, reporting level=1 features=1 while the task expects L2. The L2 subsystem files (icache.sv, dcache.sv, branch_predictor.sv) exist in the file inventory and the if_stage/mem_stage carry bus-handshake ports (cpu_req_*/cpu_resp_*, bp_lookup_pc/bp_pred_*), yet the performance log shows ooo_bypass=0 and the top-level reports only L1 features. This means rtl/rv32i5.sv drives dbg_features (and likely the dbg_bp_*/dbg_ooo_* capability observables) with a value/constant that encodes only the base 5-stage pipeline (features=1), i.e. the L2 cache + dynamic-branch-prediction + OoO-bypass feature bits are never asserted — so the teacher TB's capability probe classifies the design as L1 even though the underlying logic can already execute the L2 benchmark correctly. Root cause: incorrect/under-asserted capability declaration in the top-level feature/observability wiring, not a datapath bug.
